name: Sticky Wings
description: Baked chicken wings glazed with a sweet and savory brown sugar and soy sauce mixture.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 300°F.
Break chicken wings apart at the joints and discard tips.
Place wings in a roasting pan and cover with the sauce mixture (brown sugar, soy sauce, garlic salt).
Bake until the sauce evaporates and wings are sticky.

keywords: sticky chicken wings, baked wings, appetizer

_similar.name: Chicken Celebrity
_similar.description: A sweet and savory chicken dish with a ketchup-based sauce, perfect for baking.

recipeInstructions.text: Arrange chicken parts in a small roaster or casserole.
Mix the rest of the ingredients together. Spoon over chicken, covering all pieces.
Bake in a 350°F oven for 1 hour or until tender.

_similar.keywords: baked chicken, sweet and savory, ketchup-based sauce

_similar.name: Sticky Chicken
_similar.description: A sweet and savory chicken dish baked in a sticky sauce with pineapple and mushrooms.

recipeInstructions.text: Shake chicken pieces in a bag with flour, paprika, ginger, and garlic powder to coat.
Combine pineapple juice and water to make 1 cup. Add brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, soya sauce, and drained mushrooms. Mix well.
Place the coated chicken in a pan, skin side down. Pour the sauce over the chicken.
Bake at 350°F, uncovered, for 1 hour. Baste often and turn the chicken at 30 minutes.
During the last 5 minutes, add drained pineapple tidbits and an additional can of drained mushrooms.

_similar.keywords: sticky chicken, baked chicken, pineapple chicken

_similar.name: Noodles with Hamburg
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground hamburger, macaroni, and a blend of vegetables and cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: In a frying pan, brown the hamburger with celery and onions (if using). Drain excess fat.
Add garlic powder, oregano, salt, tomato soup, corn, and canned tomatoes to the browned hamburger mixture. Stir to combine.
Simmer the mixture slowly for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook macaroni according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Combine the cooked macaroni with the hamburger and sauce mixture. Stir well.
If using cheese, heat it until melted and mix into the noodle and hamburger mixture.
Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: hamburger casserole, noodle dish, comfort food

_similar.name: Meat Balls and Sour And Sweet Sauce
_similar.description: A classic meatball recipe served in a tangy sweet and sour sauce, perfect for serving over meatballs, chicken, or pork chops.
recipeIngredient: 1 tsp onion flakes or 1 tsp real onion

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together and form into 1½ inch balls.
Bake in an ungreased oblong pan for 20 to 25 minutes at 400°F.
Remove from oven and drain grease.
Place meatballs in a large casserole.
Pour sweet and sour sauce over the top and return to oven for 10 minutes or until hot.
To make the sauce, mix all ingredients together in a saucepan and stir while bringing to a boil until thickened.

_similar.keywords: meatballs, sweet and sour sauce, baked meatballs

_similar.name: Thai Chicken
_similar.description: A Thai-inspired chicken dish with spaghetti, vegetables, and a tangy sauce, served hot or chilled.
recipeIngredient: 2 tsp Sambal Oelek or hot pepper sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Cook pasta according to package directions for the minimum time. Drain, rinse with cold water, and drain again.
Stir pasta in a large bowl to coat with sesame oil.
Finely grate the peel from 1 lime and squeeze juice to measure 1/4 cup. Stir juice, peel, soya sauce, hot pepper sauce, salt, and sugar into pasta.
Slice chicken into bite-size pieces, thinly slice pepper, onion, and celery, and julienne carrots.
Stir-fry chicken in batches and return to the pan with garlic and onions. Stir-fry about 3 minutes.
Stir in water, peppers, celery, and carrots. Continue stirring about 3 minutes, adding a bit more water if necessary.
Add snow peas and stir about 1 minute.
Toss with the pasta, serve right away, or chill overnight and serve cold the next day.
